# TechGnomo

> Fabio D’Anna’s workshop in Brisbane. A personal site, not a company. He is a hospitality professional moving into IT.

TechGnomo publishes useful software with an honest status (idea, experiment, prototype, alpha, beta, live, mature, archived). AI, automation and cybersecurity are learning, not services.

## Pages

- [Home](https://techgnomo.com/): who he is, and three ways in
- [Workshop](https://techgnomo.com/workshop.html): ClearMoneyPath (beta), GnomoRestaurant (prototype), MVP Scope Checker (live)
- [ClearMoneyPath](https://techgnomo.com/clearmoneypath.html): pay-cycle planner, Android beta, screens use sample data
- [GnomoRestaurant](https://techgnomo.com/gnomorestaurant.html): hospitality prototype, no public screenshots
- [Hire Fabio](https://techgnomo.com/hire.html): web résumé, no PDF
- [For venues](https://techgnomo.com/work-with.html): two small fixed-price jobs
- [Lab](https://techgnomo.com/lab.html): the scope checker, and what he is learning
- [MVP Scope Checker](https://techgnomo.com/mvp-scope-checker.html): free browser tool, nothing uploaded
- [Contact](https://techgnomo.com/contact.html): gnomocode@gmail.com
